---
name: Bug report
about: Something does not work as expected
labels: bug
---
**What happens, and what should happen**

**How to reproduce** (chapter and place, keys or buttons pressed, settings changed)

**System** (Windows version, Python version, graphics card, gamepad if any)

**Log** (the error printed in the console or the end of `data\logs\window_errors.log`)

Please do not attach game files (APKs, saves) or screenshots containing large parts of the game.
